subject: problem with libpardiso.so in inla binary install

messages.author: 2fd6304ad8dd07e2
messages.subject: problem with libpardiso.so in inla binary install
parts:
Dear INLA users

We are having an issue which seems to be caused by the incompatibility of the standard INLA package with Redhat based systems. The cluster we are running INLA on is based on the Centos 7 distribution. We first got the following message:

"/lib64/libm.so.6: version `GLIBC_x.xx' not found"

To try to fix it, we tried the binary version of INLA. Thereafter, the following message appeared:

 "/scratch/apps/gnu/R-4.1.1/lib64/R/library/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/inla.mkl: error while loading shared libraries: libpardiso.so: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory".

We were not going to use pardiso in this application due to new licensing issues, but it seems that even in this situation the package depends on this library.

 

Márcio Laurini

let me know if that does not work out
